name: Job Search Agent
description: Self-hosted tool that searches the web for job postings matching a resume (via Claude's web search) and scores them strong / good / watch on a local web dashboard (python app.py, http://localhost:<PORT>, default 5000). Runs on demand or on a schedule. This card only describes the app for discovery: the app does not implement the A2A protocol, so no A2A endpoint URL is given. Every fact here comes from this project's README.

skills.name: Read a resume (PDF, DOCX or text)
Search target companies' career pages and the web for matching roles
Score each posting as a strong, good or watch match
Run searches on demand or on a schedule
